study_identification_part.si_4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Two target cohorts (ADNI, NIMHANS) plus a TractoInferno pretraining dataset.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "In total, we analyzed diffusion data of 1032 subjects from two cohorts - 730 participants from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) Phase 3 ... and an independent sample of 302 Indian-ancestry participants... (NIMHANS)"; "In our study, this pretraining dataset consisted of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes already preprocessed from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset"

answer.TractoInferno: Pretraining dataset for the VAE normative model (healthy controls).

answer.ADNI: Target dataset; CN split for fine-tuning/validation/testing and model inference on all ADNI participants (CN, MCI, dementia).

answer.NIMHANS: Target dataset; CN split for fine-tuning/validation/testing and model inference on all NIMHANS participants (CN, MCI, dementia).

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: VAE pretrained on TractoInferno; then fine-tuned on CN split in each cohort; inference on full cohort with MCI/dementia included in test set.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "A VAE model is first trained on healthy controls from a pretraining dataset (TractoInferno). For each target dataset (ADNI, NIMHANS), the controls are split into two sets (Split 1 and Split 2), and Split 1 is used to fine-tune the VAE model. We then perform model inference on all data from the target dataset"; "For both the ADNI and NIMHANS datasets, data from the CN participants were split into independent subsets of size 35%/15%/50% for training/validation/testing. Data from participants with MCI or dementia were concatenated with the 50% CN subjects to create the test set."
